title: Prelude
description: Switch between Nextendo Network and Nintendo's official network services.
author: Nextendo Network
details:
Prelude is a homebrew application for switching between Nextendo Network and Nintendo's official network services.

Nextendo mode configures the Atmosphere files and patches needed to connect supported games and services to Nextendo Network. Nintendo mode removes Prelude's changes and restores the console's normal Nintendo network configuration.

Prelude applies its changes through files and settings that Atmosphere reads at boot, making the process reversible. After selecting a network mode, the console reboots so the new configuration can take effect.
changelog:
v4.0.14

## Prelude v4.0.14

**New: World War Z online on Nextendo.**

- Redirects Saber's online service hosts to Nextendo: `wwz.wwzapi.com`, `wwz-production.wwzapi.com`, `wwzprod.wwzapi.com`, `rlx.hydrapi.net` and `rlxp1a1l.hydrapi.net`. Without these lines the game tries to reach Saber's original servers and cannot go online.
- No ExeFS patches are needed. The console's SSL verification patch that Nextendo mode already installs covers this game.
- Update, open Prelude once in Nextendo mode to apply the hosts, then **fully power off and restart** the console (the hosts file is only read at boot).

What works: signing in, the online main menu, creating a squad and starting Find Match.

Known issues: World War Z online is an early test. Two players can be placed in the same search, but joining a match is not working yet and may end with "connection lost". This is being worked on server-side; no further Prelude update should be needed for it.

Everything from 4.0.13 (Nintendo DNS blocking, PRODINFO settings, mode-switch recovery) is unchanged.

Full changelog: https://github.com/NextendoNetwork/Prelude-Nextendo/compare/v4.0.13...v4.0.14
